crossRefs.note: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.
But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.
Yahweh God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a…
By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
So also it is written, “The first man, Adam, became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

translations.web: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

translations.kjv: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.
translations.asv: The Spirit of God hath made me, And the breath of the Almighty giveth me life.
